text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the end-of-school-year spring cleaning.
We clean up the Trainer's Office before the new semester begins.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"If you've got trash, hand it over.
I'll take it all at once!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not wanting to keep her waiting, I quickly sift through the papers to see what can be discarded.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Flutter...)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What fell to the floor was a scrap of paper.
I pick it up.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? The one you won in that raffle back then!?
You bastard, you still haven't used it!?
choice_data_list: Um, I never had a chance to use it anyway...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Ehhh~...!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
“...... Well, things sure have been
hectic lately, haven't they?”

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Once we're done cleaning, let's head out!
Then we'll feel totally refreshed!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "And so we'll wash it all away clean—and call it a day."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Oho~~, this place has a great vibe!
And it's huge!!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I bet the bathhouse is huge too!!
Come on, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Gimme the luggage.
It'll be faster if I carry it than if you do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Oh, you made it up too, huh?
choice_data_list: Ah, I ended up staying in the bath a little too long.
Yeah, I ended up soaking in the bath too long.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Thought as much, so I bought some.
Here."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"The water wasn't too hot, after all.
Knowing you, you'd probably just zone out in it, right?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I can read your every move like a book.
So, what's next...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hadn't planned anything specific after this.
Once we cool off a bit, we could head back to the academy, but—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Alright.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait right there, Trainer!
I'm gonna go ask that person over there real quick!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
There's gotta be somewhere to hang out nearby!
There's no way there's nothing!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And what Espoir City found
was a local neighborhood festival.
choice_data_list: And before I knew it, she was in a different yukata...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, it was a free service at the inn!
Might as well enjoy it to the absolute fullest!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I can't help but marvel at Espoir City's skill over the past while. To gather information so swiftly and put it to such good use...
choice_data_list: Maybe there's nothing left for me to teach you.
Maybe there's nothing left for me to teach you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how much Espoir City had grown even in her daily life,
I was suddenly overwhelmed with emotion.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, pretty much. I mean, I am perfection.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
“...C'mon, let's hurry up and hit the stalls.
First up, bouncy ball scooping!”

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Oryaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Espoir City aggressively thrust her paper scooper
right into the water where the small rubber balls floated!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Gaaahhh?! Not even a single ball left...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Espoir City stared intently at the ripped scooper.
It was a truly spectacular... failure!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Guh...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Don't laugh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Moving the scooper with brute force was probably
the biggest reason for failure. If it's something
like this... maybe I'm still better at it."
choice_data_list: Then next time, I'll get my revenge!
Then next time, I'll get my revenge!

text_block_list.name: Food Stall Man
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, is that so, is that so!
You're full of motivation, aren't ya? Alright, thanks for your business!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Holding her frustration close to heart, I carefully ready the scooper.
This is—our revenge match.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...You really hold that scooper right from the base, huh.
choice_data_list: Here's the trick to scooping it well.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hoo boy...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Watching the flow of the water's surface, I bring the paper scoop closer to the ball. ...Just like this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Plop!)

text_block_list.name: Food Stall Man
text_block_list.text:
Impressive, you're real good at this!
Even the young lady was blown away, wasn't she?
choice_data_list: Want to try Espo again next time?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
! H-Haaah!? What's with that look?!
I'll show you! Next time's totally gonna work!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I mean, do it next to me, bastard!
And that move from earlier too! Do it one more time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rattle-clatter!)

text_block_list.name: Food Stall Man
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you've gotten pretty darn good at this,
Umamusume missy!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, darn right!
Because...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hey, you got anything else you're good at?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Ring toss or yo-yo fishing?
Come on, show me your moves!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before I knew it, she was leading me by the hand from one food stall to the next, just like children who hadn't had their fill of fun yet.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
So!?
Where are you supposed to look when you throw the ring!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Target shooting once this is over!
Hit it in one shot!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Alright, next is over there!
Trainer! Next time, we're...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, the hands of the clock point to a later hour than intended.
—That'll be all for today.
choice_data_list: Espo, let's head back to the ryokan soon.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: No way!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: No way! Screw that! I'm not going back!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I mean, there are still stalls we haven't hit yet! Besides, the festival isn't even over yet!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I already decided I'm learning from you today!
You're gonna teach me all the food stall tricks!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
That's why... NO WAY!!
'Cause I ain't satisfied yet!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...No way.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Teach me everything properly until the very end.
You haven't taught me everything yet, have you?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
So... don't you dare let it end.
...Don't you end it.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...I really hate this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Even after that, she didn't
make a single move to budge.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Did this festival stall really hit the spot with her that much?
...Talk about stubborn.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yet precisely because Espoir City was so stubborn and uncompromising... she was able to achieve all her great feats up until now.
choice_data_list: ...Good grief, you really leave me no choice.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ! Does that mean—
choice_data_list: Just a little further to go!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah!
Stick with me just a little longer!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hey! You hurry up and get over here too!!
We're gonna have a blast together!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Even just a little bit more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And after that,
we ended up strolling around the stalls together
until the festival lanterns were finally extinguished.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"We really need to get back to the inn
and start packing up to leave.
I need to let Espoir City know, too—"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —It's all over.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...—Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Espoir City looked back at the festival venue with reluctance.
I waited for her for a little while.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt
an irreplaceable bond
with Espoir City...
